notes.title: Something Is Stirring in the Kingdom… – Join Our Newsletter!
notes.notes:
Hello adventurers,

It’s been a while! If you’ve ever ventured through Notrium and felt the thrill of discovery, the excitement of battle, or the quiet charm of a well-placed secret—we’d love to reconnect with you.

We’ve been working on new ideas, updates, and maybe even something big 👀. And the best way to stay in the loop? Our official newsletter. No spam, just the good stuff—development insights, sneak peeks, community highlights, and early access opportunities. And if you don't want to hear from us very often, you can also choose to only be notified of new games, or most important updates. And there is also a surprise!

👉 Sign up here: https://www.instantkingdom.com/newsletter/

Whether you played for hours or just crash landed on Notrium, you’re part of the story. And we want you along for what’s next.

– Ville from Instant Kingdom

notes.title: 11 years in the making: Wazzal II mod
notes.notes:
Today marks the release of Wazzal II, the Notrium mod that ZeXLR8er started way back in 2004. I've been [url=http://www.instantkingdom.com/forum/viewtopic.php?t=823]following its progress[/url] for quite a while now. Things looked like stalling for a few years, but we never gave up hope! It's a great mod, so I want you to [url=https://github.com/zexlr8er/Wazzal_II/releases]download and play it[/url], and take some time to praise ZeXLR8er for his hard work. 


[img]http://images.instantkingdom.com/2016/02/wazzal2mod/banner_650.jpg[/img]


[h1]36 years after the events of Wazzal, and four years after Notrium...[/h1]
[i]After the sun was destroyed by a supernova and most of humankind mysteriously abducted by a shadowy Alien race, a handful of brave space pilots established a new colony in the depths of space. Wasting no time, this motley collection of adventurers, traders and buccaneers set off to explore their new corner of the galaxy. Soon the United Confederacy of Planets was formed, heralding a new dawn for humankind free from Alien interference.



After many years of peace, the Alien threat has re-emerged to finish what they started! The Confederacy is in ultimate peril as massive Alien fleets begin their relentless drive towards the capital New Dawn, leaving nothing alive. Humankind's last hope lays on the shoulders of the most famous of the human pilots: the enigmatic "Captain", survivor of the doomed Sol System and the terrible planet of Notrium....[/i]



[img]http://images.instantkingdom.com/2016/02/wazzal2mod/thumbnail.jpg[/img]



[h1]Mod features[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Two gameplay modes[/b]: starship combat and exploration aboard the Wolf IV, and on foot as the legendary "Captain" from Notrium and Wazzal![/*]
[*][b]Eight completely unique star systems, and fourteen planets and space stations[/b] to explore (including lava, ocean, ice, desert and jungle worlds, low gravity moons, gas giants and Alien planets!)[/*]
[*]Over [b]100 items[/b] to use in both space and on planets, including electrobinoculars, night vision goggles, stealth armor and high explosives
[/*]
[*]More than [b]40 weapons[/b], including sniper rifles, particle cannons, rocket propelled grenades and Alien technology[/*]
[*][b]Six controllable vehicles[/b], including tanks (armed with cannons and flamethrowers), armored boats (armed with machine guns), fighters (armed with airstrikes and lasers), machine gun emplacements, flamethrower pillboxes and even Confederacy Destroyers![/*]
[*][b]11 United Confederacy Ranks[/b] (Ensign to Admiral of the Fleet) with valuable rewards for completing ingame missions[/*]
[*]Fly the flag of the [b]United Confederacy of Planets[/b], abandon your duties to [b]raid and plunder as a ruthless pirate[/b], or even [b]join the dreaded Alien Horde[/b]![/*]
[*]Make a fortune trading slaves, drugs and weapon parts on the [b]Galactic Stock Exchange[/b], hunting for [b]dangerous local creatures, farming rare plants, mining for ore[/b] or even [b]fishing[/b]!
[/list]
